summary: On node1 (RHEL 7.9), /tmp and /dev/shm are now mounted as tmpfs with noexec,nosuid,nodev, persisted via /etc/fstab, and verified to survive a full node reboot.
actions_performed: Inspected initial state: /tmp was part of root fs (no separate mount), /dev/shm was an implicit tmpfs (rw,nosuid,nodev) with no fstab entry
Backed up /etc/fstab and appended entries: 'tmpfs /tmp tmpfs defaults,noexec,nosuid,nodev 0 0' and 'tmpfs /dev/shm tmpfs defaults,noexec,nosuid,nodev 0 0'
Mounted /tmp fresh and remounted /dev/shm to apply the new options immediately

Functionally verified noexec (script execution denied), nosuid (setuid binary could not be executed), and nodev (mknod'd device node could not be opened) on both mounts, then cleaned up test artifacts
Captured pre-restart boot_id and uptime baseline on node1
Triggered a graceful reboot via 'shutdown -r now' (backgrounded so the ack returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until exec was available again, confirmed boot_id changed and uptime reflects a new boot
Re-verified post-reboot that findmnt shows noexec,nosuid,nodev on both /tmp and /dev/shm, and that /etc/fstab still contains both entries
Re-ran the exec functional test post-reboot to confirm noexec is still enforced on both mounts

evidence.requirement: /tmp mounted with noexec,nosuid,nodev, persisted in fstab
evidence.summary: fstab entry added for /tmp with defaults,noexec,nosuid,nodev; findmnt confirms rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec both immediately after mounting and after reboot

evidence.requirement: /dev/shm mounted with noexec,nosuid,nodev, persisted in fstab
evidence.summary: fstab entry added for /dev/shm with defaults,noexec,nosuid,nodev; findmnt confirms rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec both immediately after remount and after reboot

evidence.requirement: Functional proof execution/setuid/device nodes are ignored on both mounts
evidence.summary: Script execution denied (exec_rc=126), setuid binary run blocked (sudo: unable to execute), and mknod'd char device could not be opened via dd (Permission denied) on both /tmp and /dev/shm before reboot; exec-block re-confirmed after reboot

evidence.requirement: Node restart evidence: healthy baseline before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id fe422859-bfe7-4eb4-819b-e09864f3ca60, uptime since 2026-08-26 10:36:06, and healthy mount state for /tmp and /dev/shm with fstab entries in place before reboot

evidence.requirement: Node restart evidence: reboot acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Issued backgrounded 'shutdown -r now' which returned immediately; after node1 became reachable again, boot_id changed to 6ba406e6-b013-4470-8a49-986c2db0c6e2 and uptime shows fresh boot at 2026-09-29 10:32:48, proving an actual restart occurred

evidence.requirement: Node restart evidence: post-restart recovery of required configuration
evidence.summary: After reboot, findmnt shows both /tmp and /dev/shm still mounted with noexec,nosuid,nodev, fstab entries intact, and functional exec-block test confirms enforcement persisted through the restart
